fact: She works as a freelance graphic designer.
She left an agency job about three years ago after burnout.
She lives with her partner Miguel; they have no children.
She has a dog named Biscuit.
She moved from Chicago to Portland two years ago for Miguel's job.
She is an introvert who keeps a few close friendships rather than a wide network.
She has managed anxiety since her twenties.
Her father lives in Chicago and taught her to draw.
Her father had a cardiac event earlier this year that he survived.
She traveled back to Chicago for two weeks after her father's health scare.
She is slowly and reluctantly trying to rebuild a social circle in Portland.
She values autonomy over income stability.
Irregular freelance income is a recurring worry for her.
Her recurring pattern is to withdraw when things get hard.
